description: One record on the wire between ecosystem components.

created_at.description: When the producer made the record, with a UTC offset. Offsets other than UTC are accepted and normalized to UTC.
created_at.title: Created At

payload.description: The record itself. Its shape belongs to the producer and the record_type, not to this envelope.
payload.title: Payload

producer.description: The component that made the record.
producer.title: Producer

record_id.description: The producer's own stable ID for the record. A producer that re-sends a record sends the same ID.
record_id.title: Record Id

record_type.description: What the payload is, in snake_case, such as 'intelligence', 'campaign_finance', 'chamber_flow' or 'brief'.
record_type.title: Record Type

schema_version.description: Envelope format version. Only '1' exists; a consumer must refuse any other value.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

title: ExchangeEnvelope
